meta.name: derisk-measurement-advisor
meta.description: Identify what to measure, test, or track to de-risk a product or AI idea. Use when stress-testing an idea across internal (DUFV) and external (PESTEL) dimensions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别产品风险并确定测量指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地评估产品或AI创意的风险并确定关键指标。
copy.tagline_en: Identify risks and define metrics for your product or AI idea
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically de-risk a product or AI idea by identifying what to measure and track.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过 10 个维度（内部 4 个、外部 6 个）扫描产品或 AI 想法的风险，并判断每个风险是“立即行动”还是“开始跟踪”，最终生成一份优先级风险登记表。
howto.when: 当你提出一个产品或 AI 想法，并希望评估其风险时触发。例如，在决定是否投入路线图之前，或需要结构化风险检查时。

say.text: 帮我评估这个 AI 想法：一个自动生成保险理赔回复的智能体。
say.note: Claude 会开始引导你完成 10 个维度的风险扫描。

say.text: 我们想把一个新产品加入路线图，先做一次风险检查。
say.note: Claude 会询问想法详情、阶段、主要担忧等上下文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through scanning a product or AI idea across 10 risk dimensions (4 internal, 6 external), triages each risk into 'act now' or 'start tracking', and produces a prioritized risk register.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a product or AI idea and want to assess its risks, e.g., before committing to a roadmap or needing a structured risk check.

say_en.text: Help me de-risk this AI idea: an agent that auto-drafts insurance claim responses.
say_en.note: Claude will start guiding you through the 10-dimension risk scan.

say_en.text: We're about to put a new product on the roadmap. Let's do a risk check first.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for context like idea, stage, primary concern, and customer.
